description: This file defines the 'SystemCheckController' class, a controller in the OrangeHRM application responsible for handling system check-related actions. It includes methods for initialization, pre-render setup, and rendering the system check page, utilizing various services and configuration settings.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: A controller class for handling system check pages within the OrangeHRM application, providing methods for initialization, rendering, and theme configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the controller and checks if the system check screen should be shown; if not, sets a 404 response.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component and template before rendering the view.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares context data and renders the system check page using Twig templates.

methods.name: getDefaultThemeVariables
methods.description: Returns an array of theme variables with default color and font settings.
